messages:
maria-ae: Sharing draft RFP response for Nightingale Health. Open: HSM/KMS language, POC duration/pricing, capability matrix decimals, and data ingress. Quick scan please.

kevin-se: I'll take POC ops/runbook. Recommend 14-day sandbox with pre-signed S3 + temp VPC peering. Teardown steps: revoke peering, delete bucket, rotate keys.

sophie-prod: I'll update capability matrix. Proposed cols: baseline t/s, burst window, p99 SLA, fallback model, cost note (one line each).

raj-security: Ingress ok via pre-signed S3. Need their security contact to sign DAA. Default retention: delete-on-teardown; audit logs 90 days. KMS passthrough requires their KMS ARN.

elaine-legal: I'll add KMS/HSM clause and attach redacted SOW. Note reserved pilots change payment milestones/liability.

ci-bot: provision-sandbox: nightingale-sbx created id sbx-5544; logs -> ops-logs.

maria-ae: Thanks. I'll assemble final packet (matrix, runbook, pricing example, DAA) and send by EOD.
